title: Kauna Grass Embroidered Handbag | Handcrafted Artisan Bag
descriptionHtml:
Kauna Grass Embroidered Handbag

Crafted from 100% natural Kauna grass and topped with smooth, sustainably harvested cane handles, this embroidered handbag is a quiet statement of artisan excellence. Each stitch tells a story of skill, patience, and heritage.

The Art of Kauna Weaving

Kauna grass, harvested from the wetlands of Manipur, is one of India's most prized natural fibers. Our artisans transform it into structured, beautiful bags that carry the soul of their makers — and the spirit of slow fashion.

Why You'll Love It

Lightweight yet structured, this bag holds its shape beautifully. The embroidered detailing adds a layer of artistry that elevates any outfit — from casual linen to evening silk.

Perfect For

Everyday carry, gifting, travel, and conscious fashion lovers who value craft over convenience.

Material & Care

100% natural Kauna grass with cane handles. Avoid moisture. Wipe gently with a dry cloth to maintain its natural finish.
